html:
Basutoland was the British protectorate over the Basotho kingdom, proclaimed on 12 March 1868 at the request of Moshoeshoe I and lasting until independence in 1966.

Britain handed it to the Cape Colony in 1871, but the Cape's attempt to disarm the Basotho led to the Gun War of 1880, and in 1884 Britain took it back under direct rule. It was governed lightly through the chiefs, with little spent on it.

When South Africa was formed in 1910, Britain kept Basutoland out of it, and later refused to hand it over to the apartheid state. As a result Lesotho became independent as a country entirely surrounded by South Africa, dependent on work in its mines. Its rule began with Moshoeshoe's appeal.
sum: Basutoland was the British protectorate over the Basotho kingdom, proclaimed on 12 March 1868 at the request of Moshoeshoe I and lasting until independence in 1966.
